name: Sea Harvest Group Limited
summary: Sea Harvest Group Limited engages in the fishing and food business serving retail and foodservice customers. The company operates through four segments: South African Fishing, Australia, Aquaculture, and Cape Harvest Foods. Its activities include the fishing of cape hake, and shark bay king and tiger prawns, as well as horse and Spanish mackerel, pilchards, anchovies, tuna, scallops, crabs, and a variety of farmed species; processing of the catch into frozen and chilled seafood; and marketing of products. The company owns and operates a fleet of 34 vessels, which include single and twin fresh fish trawlers, factory freezer trawlers, and access to in-shore trawlers that catch and process cape hake and other species, as well as by-catch species. It also has 12 prawn vessels, which catch and process prawns, scallops, crabs, and related by-catch species. The company distributes various chilled and frozen food products through its distribution network; and to local supermarket chains in South Africa, as well as supplies its products to 30 countries worldwide. It also imports and distributes frozen seafood to the catering and hospitality industry. In addition, the company engages in the aquaculture business, as wells as provides abalone, mussels, oysters, and trout farming services. Further, it is involved in the production, distribution, marketing, and sale of value-added dairy products to the South African retail, wholesale, foodservice, and food ingredients markets. The company was formerly known as Sea Harvest Holdings Proprietary Limited and changed its name to Sea Harvest Group Limited in February 2017. Sea Harvest Group Limited was founded in 1964 and is headquartered in Cape Town, South Africa. Sea Harvest Group Limited is a subsidiary of Brimco Proprietary Limited.
